μ - miu: Launched on August 18, 2026, MIU is the first token launched and first deployment on uTokenPro, making it a piece of the launchpad’s history.

MIU represents the beginning of the uTokenPro ecosystem and serves as the official mascot of the memes, culture, and community built around the launchpad.
